name: On-policy (student-state) teacher distillation (OTD) -- DAgger-style successor to TEACHER_DISTILLATION_SPEC.json
authority: PI, 2026-09-04: do not go back to PPO, retention, BCS or Z-separation. The offline-distilled student reproduced teacher-level fidelity and teacher-level z0/z1 JSD but only attenuated closed-loop crossover; the strongest hypothesis is covariate shift / compounding imitation error. Teach the student how the specialists behave in the states the student itself causes. Two frozen rounds, fixed episode counts, fixed epochs, no stopping on any win-rate. Add the missing diagnostic: teacher fidelity on student-generated states.

PARENT_RESULT.reading: policy-level compression succeeded (fidelity, separation); payoff-level crossover was attenuated (both deltas positive, neither CI clears zero). Not a catastrophic compression failure -- the student appears to hold the right strategies; their closed-loop execution is less faithful than the static fidelity numbers suggest.

HYPOTHESIS.name: covariate shift / compounding imitation error
HYPOTHESIS.mechanism: the student was trained on states generated by the TEACHERS (pi_A deployed on A, pi_B deployed on B). At deployment the student drives its own state distribution: a small per-decision mismatch (3-4%) changes the next state, reaching states rarer or absent in the teacher dataset, where the student was never supervised -- errors compound and the payoff margin erodes.
HYPOTHESIS.prediction_that_makes_this_falsifiable: teacher-agreement measured on states the STUDENT itself visits (on-policy fidelity) is materially lower than the 0.965/0.984 measured on teacher-visited states. If on-policy fidelity is NOT lower, this hypothesis is wrong and the FAIL must be attributed elsewhere (architecture sharing).

DESIGN.start_from: the FROZEN offline-distilled student (TEACHER_DISTILLATION_STUDENT_FROZEN.json, sha-verified) -- not the incumbent, not a fresh init
DESIGN.round_structure: TD student -> student-state collection (round 1) -> distill -> student-state collection (round 2) -> distill -> freeze -> sealed eval. Exactly two rounds. No third round is authorised by this spec regardless of any number.

student_state_collection_per_round.acting_policy: the CURRENT student (the one that will next be trained), forced z per cell, deterministic actions -- the exact deployment convention the sealed eval uses, so the collected states ARE the deployment distribution
student_state_collection_per_round.why_all_four_cells: the sealed eval scores all four; the off-diagonal cells (z1 on A, z0 on B) are part of the distribution the gate visits and are where the wrong-latent student goes -- they must be supervised too
student_state_collection_per_round.what_is_stored: every decision-bearing pre-action state with the exact observation dict, the live decision mask (decision_mask_from_core, fatal if absent), state-origin pole, the z that generated it, episode and seed. Decision rows only.
student_state_collection_per_round.labels: NOT cached at collection. Both frozen teachers are queried on every stored state at training time through the same masked-head path as before: z0 -> pi_A(.|s), z1 -> pi_B(.|s) on the SAME s.

DESIGN.training_mixture_per_round: DAgger aggregation: the original 35,005 teacher-state rows (TEACHER_DISTILLATION_DATASET.json, minus its original 10% holdout) UNION student-state rows from every round so far (minus each round's holdout). Plain union, no reweighting -- no new hyperparameter. Minibatches stratified by state-origin pole exactly as before.
DESIGN.loss: identical to TEACHER_DISTILLATION_SPEC.json#LOSS: 0.5*KL(pi_A||pi_theta(.|z0)) + 0.5*KL(pi_B||pi_theta(.|z1)), decision-boundary heads only, actor parameters only

training_per_round.optimizer: fresh Adam over actor parameters each round (no optimizer state carried)
training_per_round.why_10_not_20: round 0 trained from random init for 20 epochs and its holdout KL plateaued by ~epoch 15. Each round here continues from an already-fitted student with ~1.7-2.3x more data; 10 fixed epochs is enough to absorb the new distribution. A judgment call, frozen here before any run, not tuned.

holdouts.teacher_states: the original 10% (episode % 10 == 9) stays held out, never trained on -- the fit check is measured here
holdouts.student_states: per round, episode index % 8 == 7 within each cell (4 of 32 per cell, 16 per round) held out from training

THE_MISSING_DIAGNOSTIC_ON_POLICY_FIDELIT.definition: teacher-agreement (argmax match at decision heads, both z) and KL measured on STUDENT-generated states
THE_MISSING_DIAGNOSTIC_ON_POLICY_FIDELIT.the_red_handed_number: before round-1 training: the offline TD student's agreement on ALL round-1 student states -- states it generated itself and has never been trained on. If offline holdout says ~0.97 but this says materially less, covariate shift is caught directly.
trajectory_across_rounds: pre-round-1: TD student on round-1 states (generated by TD student)
post-round-1: round-1 student on round-1 HELD-OUT states (generated by the TD student -- slightly off-policy for the new student; labelled as such)
pre-round-2: round-1 student on ALL round-2 states (generated by the round-1 student itself -- the clean post-round-1 on-policy number)
post-round-2: round-2 student on round-2 held-out states (same caveat). The round-2 student's clean on-policy fidelity has no fresh collection before the seal -- the sealed eval is its test.
THE_MISSING_DIAGNOSTIC_ON_POLICY_FIDELIT.status: DIAGNOSTIC. Reported in every record, never a gate, never a stopping criterion. Crossover remains the only scientific gate.

FIT_CHECK_BEFORE_THE_SEAL: unchanged from TEACHER_DISTILLATION_SPEC.json: teacher-state holdout agreement >= 0.50 for both z after round 2. Guards against the DAgger rounds degrading the student on the original distribution. On-policy fidelity is reported alongside but is NOT part of the fit check.

SEEDS.disjointness_confirmed: exact literals and the 1193[1-3]xxxx pattern grepped against every JSON under artifacts/strategic_demand/sppo/ before freezing -- zero hits

DEVICE_RULE_FROZEN_IN_ADVANCE.training_and_collection: cpu (supervised, small; and the measured rollout bottleneck is CPU-side env stepping, GPU util ~7%)
DEVICE_RULE_FROZEN_IN_ADVANCE.sealed_eval: CONTINGENT, decided by a mechanical check that does not look at any outcome: the 8-seed episode-length diagnostic (11930001..11930008) is rerun on cuda and compared to its cpu run. If every episode's step count and (blue, red) score are identical across devices, the sealed eval runs on cpu (measured ~4-5x faster for this single-env pattern). If ANY episode differs, the sealed eval runs on cuda for strict comparability with COMPRESSION_CROSSOVER_EVAL_RESULT.json. The outcome of that check is recorded in an append-only amendment before the seal is opened.

MECHANICAL_PREFLIGHT_REQUIRED_BEFORE_EAC: teacher dataset and every student-state round load; both poles present; holdouts non-empty
the starting student loads and matches its frozen sha; parameter names/shapes match the incumbent architecture
teacher self-agreement on the NEW student states is exactly 1.0 and teacher self-KL exactly 0 (positive control of the fidelity path on the new distribution)
gradient on actor parameters, NONE on critic parameters
one optimizer step moves actor parameters only; critic bit-identical
checkpoint round-trip reproduces masked logits exactly

PRIMARY_GATE.criterion: delta_A > 0 AND LCB95(delta_A) > 0 AND delta_B > 0 AND LCB95(delta_B) > 0
PRIMARY_GATE.rule: same primary gate as every prior stage. No mercy, no reinterpretation.

EVAL_PROTOCOL_ONPOLICY_COMPRESSION_CROSS.bootstrap: paired percentile bootstrap over seeds, n_boot=20000, alpha=0.05, rng_seed=7
EVAL_PROTOCOL_ONPOLICY_COMPRESSION_CROSS.tie_or_reversal: any tie or reversal triggers a row-level integrity audit before interpretation, written before its rows are read
EVAL_PROTOCOL_ONPOLICY_COMPRESSION_CROSS.context_only: COMPRESSION_CROSSOVER_EVAL_RESULT.json (offline TD, FAIL) and SPECIALIST_BASELINE_EVAL_RESULT.json (ceiling) reported alongside; different seed blocks; descriptive only

PREREGISTERED_INTERPRETATION.reading: student-state distillation recovered robust closed-loop crossover that one-shot offline distillation could not -- covariate shift / compounding imitation error was the mechanism. Story: offline distillation -> high policy fidelity, unconfirmed crossover; on-policy distillation -> confirmed crossover.

covariate shift was real and was corrected, yet payoff crossover still does not clear the gate at n=64 -- the remaining bottleneck is more likely representational: how much parameter sharing the latent architecture tolerates. Successor: the sharing ladder (two complete actors selected by z -> shared encoder + separate bodies -> current shared body + separate branches), preregistered separately.

two rounds of student-state supervision did not raise fidelity on the student's own states -- the shared architecture may be unable to represent both teachers on the deployment distribution. Successor: the sharing ladder. A third DAgger round is NOT implied by this spec.

PREREGISTERED_INTERPRETATION.note: 'materially improved' is judged from the reported diagnostic trajectory; it is a reading aid for choosing the successor, never a gate and never a reason to rerun the seal

NOT_RUN_UNDER_THIS_SPEC: architecture changes (that is the successor, if needed)
SEQUENCE: freeze this spec -> device A/B on the 8 diagnostic seeds (mechanical) -> round-1 student-state collection (cpu) -> round-1 preflight 7/7 -> round-1 distillation (10 epochs) -> round-2 collection from the round-1 student -> round-2 preflight -> round-2 distillation -> fit check -> freeze + hash -> ONPOLICY COMPRESSION CROSSOVER sealed eval (device per the frozen contingent rule)
